description: UPDATES a subscription — reschedule its next run (next_transaction_date), change its frequency, or activate/pause it (is_active). This MODIFIES live store data and affects future billing. Foxy hAPI: PATCH /subscriptions/{id}. Provide only the fields you want to change.

is_active.description: Set true to activate or false to pause the subscription.

next_transaction_date.description: Next run date, YYYY-MM-DD (reschedules the subscription).

name: foxy_update_subscription
title: Update subscription
